name: optimize
description:
Iterative metric-driven optimization with interactive batched experimentation. setup → metric-script validation → baseline (cost projection) → batched experimentation loop with discussion checkpoints between batches → synthesis → code-review → completion (squash from optimize.best_commit, MR/PR with leaderboard).

Example: protocol_start(protocol_name="optimize") to tune a Python hot loop's wall-clock runtime metric — discussion checkpoints after each batch let you steer or abort.

steps.name: setup
steps.description: Interactive metric elicitation; persists settings to optimize-state.json; auto-creates task file + branch + issue
steps.end: User has approved metric definition, scope, batch size, and termination conditions. Task file is composed and optimize-state.json fields are populated. Pass args including required {metric_command, metric_parser, metric_direction, metric_monotonic, task, branch, task_content} plus any optional overrides to protocol_advance.

steps.name: metric-script
steps.description: Author/refine the measurement script; validate via double-run stability gate
steps.end: Metric script exists, runs cleanly, parser yields a float, and two consecutive runs are within stability_threshold_pct (default 5%). If the validator fails, fix the script and call protocol_advance again — the validator re-runs from this step's post_funcs.

steps.name: baseline
steps.description: Capture baseline metric on HEAD; project total cost from real timing
steps.end: Baseline metric captured; baseline_wall_clock_s and optimize.baseline_commit recorded. Cost projection presented to user. If both max_iterations and max_duration are null (unbounded mode), include args["unbounded_acknowledged"]="i-accept-unbounded-cost" in the next protocol_advance.

steps.name: experimentation
steps.description: Batched hypothesis loop: each iteration commits one hypothesis, runs the metric, logs a TSV row; checkpoints fire at batch boundaries
steps.end: Experimentation terminates either by check_termination (max_iterations / max_duration / regression_halt / target_reached) or by user passing args["exit_loop"]=true at a batch boundary. optimize.best_commit and optimize.best_metric are recorded in task frontmatter for the synthesis and completion steps.

steps.name: synthesis
steps.end: Findings written to task work log. policy_compliance_audit results (metric_gaming_flags, if any) propagated as advisory data into the next step's prompt. This step never blocks advance.

steps.name: code-review
steps.description: Spec-compliance review + code-quality review on the cumulative diff baseline..best_commit
steps.end: Spec compliance review passed (SPEC_REVIEW: PASSED sentinel recorded). Code review passes with zero critical issues. Final passing review appended to task work log under '# Code Review:'. Advance summary contains verification evidence or 'no-verification-applicable: <reason>'.

steps.name: completion
steps.description: User confirms; engine squashes from optimize.best_commit and creates MR/PR with leaderboard
steps.end: User has confirmed. completion_dispatch routes to _completion_optimize: squash from optimize.best_commit (provider chain) or one of merge_local/push_pr/keep/discard (disabled-provider menu). MR/PR description includes the sorted markdown leaderboard from results.tsv.
